narrative.summary: BioGraph Steward connects scoped questions to Pharos-based evidence graphs, cited answers and auditable exports. The core workflow is operational; our focus is now measuring biological value and validating usability.
accomplishments: Built a guided Pharos/CIViC workbench with source inspection, review of proposed changes and exports preserving the full graph, original evidence and edge decisions.
Integrated IntAct/IMEx records with the official JAMI reader and PSI-MI vocabulary. Development checks preserve identities, assay methods and references; richer XML audits retain experiment context.

Connected NVIDIA Nemotron through vLLM for optional construction planning, with explicit scope checks and user review. Deterministic execution supports the current workflow while broader agent reliability remains under development.
Established reproducible comparisons with PyKEEN R-GCN and ComplEx. Adding Gene Ontology hierarchy gave no consistent gain; next we will test Reactome context already retrieved from Pharos.

Published qualified assay observations, including nondetections. Assisted user feedback improved export guidance. MIT-licensed code passes isolated build, installation and offline replay checks; Docker/Brev configuration is available.
blockers: The core workflow is ready for assessment. We still need to demonstrate improved biological predictions and verify that the evaluation evidence is sufficiently independent of our inputs.
Final evaluation rules are prepared. We will freeze the evaluation workflow, check for overlap between evaluation evidence and graph inputs, and run an independent user pilot.
Clarification of the organizer baseline, scoring and submission format will guide final packaging. Brev compute and AWS credits are available; infrastructure access is not currently a blocker.
milestones: Compare the fixed Pharos/GO graph with the same graph plus Reactome memberships, holding the learner and assay pairs constant; report development results and coverage effects.
Complete source and overlap checks, test preservation of curated evidence, and run an independent colleague walkthrough.
Release a reproducible demonstration with manifests and evaluation results; verify real-data replay and deploy on AWS if the demonstration requires it.

editorial_scope: Capabilities, incorporated tools/methods and remaining work. Historical request counts omitted. Source consistency is distinguished from prediction gain; independent user success is not claimed.
intervention_status: Reactome-only context selected; projection, preflight and execution freeze pending; no training run
